_note: Module payloads, copied in SHAPE from what a store's own modules return - Shipping/Flat::quotes() and Payment/MoneyOrder::selection(). Nothing here is captured: both endpoints are POSTs against a server-held checkout draft, and this package is public. MoneyOrder is used on purpose - it is the one payment module with no gateway, no API keys and no redirect, which makes it the honest default for a kit that never contacts anything.

shipping_methods.name: Flat Rate
shipping_methods.description: A single delivery rate for every order.

_tax_note: tax = 8.25 is 9.375% of the subtotal, the rate on the San Jose shipping address in customer.json. Set it to 0 to see the checkout a tax-free destination produces - the theme hides the Sales Tax row when it is not above zero, and that empty state needs designing too.
